messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT: P0 - Hosted inference spike for model:redwood-base-4q. Increased 5xx + tail latency detected. Triggered at 2026-03-16T22:14:30Z. Paging @clare @alex. Creating incident channel #inc-3876543210
clare: ack. I'm on it. Can someone grab the runbook and confirm customer impact (top 10 callers)?
alex: on it. looking at dashboards — errors concentrated on KV cache miss storm on shard g3-1, batching queue depth climbing. P95 latency 60ms -> 1.2s on affected pool.
ben: seeing large allocations in runtime logs tied to quantized kernels after KV evictions. suspect quant path regression with eviction churn. Recommend disabling quant path on pool as temporary mitigation.
maya: starting traffic shift to fallback model 'redwood-base-1.0' (non-quant). Canary 5% now.
ops-bot: deploy: traffic-shift initiated -> 5% fallback at 2026-03-16T22:19:12Z
sam: purged KV for affected shard: `rh-kvctl purge --shard g3-1` — monitoring for rebuild storms.
clare: thanks. @maya @sam keep watch. Alex, can you bump capacity temporarily and open a remediation ticket? I'll assemble impact notes.
alex: scaled dedicated pool g3-1 +2 GPUs for headroom. New capacity online 22:21Z. Opened ticket RINF-4533 for runtime guard work.
pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged by clare at 22:22Z. No customer-facing outage reported; some clients auto-retried.
maya: after fallback shift, error rate down ~70%, P95 improves to ~140ms. Still seeing elevated CPU and KV churn on g3-1.
clare: we'll maintain active mitigation. Plan postmortem: 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Owners: alex (root cause), maya (routing/rollout), ben (quant regression), sam (KV tuning).
ben: action: create regression repro tests for quant kernels and CI job. Ticket: RINF-4532.
alex: action: add guard in runtime to prevent quant kernel init during heavy KV eviction (throttle or fallback). Ticket: RINF-4533.
sam: action: tune KV metrics alerts, implement staggered purges and backoff, add circuit-breaker for cache rebuilds. Ticket: RINF-4534.
maya: action: add automatic fallback routing policy: if P95 > 500ms for 2m, shift 30% traffic to fallback. Ticket: RINF-4535.
clare: I'll own the postmortem doc and schedule. Draft will be at /docs/incidents/3876543210-postmortem.md; I'll populate tickets + timelines.
ops-bot: reminder: pagerduty handoff in 30m to night oncall @sam-night
clare: handing to @sam for overnight monitoring at 22:45Z. If error rate >10% above baseline, escalate to oncall. Leaving mitigations active. Notifying #customers-impacted for CS FYI.
sam: ack, I'm on overnight. Will keep runbook open and watch the dashboards. If stable, will close incident and move to remediation tracking.
clare: post-incident checklist (short): 1) collect traces for top 5 failing requests 2) save KV heap snapshots 3) verify canary no regression 4) ben: add regression tests 5) alex: ship runtime guard.
sam: status update 23:30Z: error rate stable, no new 5xx. Monitoring with elevated alerting.
clare: downgrading active paging, incident moved to SEV2 for remediation tracking. Mitigation -> stable. Postmortem + tickets to track follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
